news_items.headline: BSX plunges ~12% after cutting FY26 guidance on WATCHMAN heart device slowdown
news_items.summary: Boston Scientific cut its FY26 organic growth guidance due to slowing WATCHMAN standalone procedure adoption and competitive pressure in EP and urology. Stock hit a two-year low of $50.04, down ~12.43% on the session.

news_items.headline: Citi lowers BSX price target to $70 from $87, maintains Buy
news_items.summary: Citi analyst Joanne Wuensch cut the price target on Boston Scientific to $70 from $87 following the guidance reduction, while retaining a Buy rating on shares.

news_items.headline: Stifel lowers BSX price target to $75 from $85, maintains Buy
news_items.summary: Stifel analyst Rick Wise reduced his price target on Boston Scientific to $75 from $85 in response to the guidance cut, keeping a Buy rating.

news_items.headline: Boston Scientific FRACTURE IDE trial of SEISMIQ 4CE coronary IVL catheter meets all primary endpoints
news_items.summary: BSX's pivotal FRACTURE IDE trial for its SEISMIQ 4CE intravascular lithotripsy catheter met all primary endpoints, a positive clinical data readout for its structural heart portfolio.

news_items.headline: Q1 2026 earnings: net sales $5.203B (+11.6%), adj EPS $0.80; FY guidance lowered
news_items.summary: Boston Scientific reported Q1 2026 net sales of $5.203B (+11.6% reported, +9.4% organic) and adjusted EPS of $0.80, meeting estimates, but accompanied the results with a lowered full-year organic growth outlook. (Note: earnings event itself is older than 7 days; guidance cut impact is a current-week catalyst.)

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Citi cut PT to $70 from $87 (maintains Buy, 2026-05-28); Stifel cut PT to $75 from $85 (maintains Buy, 2026-05-28). Broader consensus average PT ~$93.18 with median ~$95.50 — both well above current stock price near $50 following the guidance-cut selloff.

earnings_context.notes: Q2 2026 earnings expected late July 2026. Street will focus on EP segment recovery trajectory, WATCHMAN FLX Pro adoption, and whether urology weakness is transient. CHAMPION clinical data is cited as a potential transformational catalyst by bulls.
